THE LANTERNS OF NOWHERE
A pamphlet by Ivo Fixture, printed at the Harbour of Nowhere, 1956.
(A fictional text for the NHI-timeline fixtures. Nothing in it is a real claim.)

I.

The harbour folk speak of lanterns over the water on still nights. I have
watched them for nine summers from the pilot steps. I say plainly that
the lanterns are a mirror, and each watcher sees in them the lamp of his
own house.

[Illustration]

II.

No lantern has ever been seen by a man who left his own lamp unlit.
